product.name: Agent-as-a-Service Platform
product.description: A platform to build and deploy AI agents without infrastructure management, enabling enterprises to create vertical AI agents connected to proprietary data.

product.name: No-Code AI Agent Builder
product.description: A drag-and-drop interface for building AI agents without coding, enabling users to design conversational flows and customize agent behavior visually.

product.name: RAG as a Service
product.description: A Retrieval-Augmented Generation service that integrates enterprise knowledge bases with AI agents, enabling enhanced data retrieval without infrastructure setup.

product.name: Comprehensive Agent & Chatbot Management
product.description: A management platform offering monitoring, analytics, and optimization tools for AI agents and chatbots to improve performance and user experience.

product.name: Flexible Deployment Options
product.description: Deployment choices including managed SaaS, on-premise installation, and private cloud to meet security and compliance needs.

product.name: Enterprise-Grade Multi-Tenancy
product.description: A platform feature enabling deployment of multiple AI agents with granular access controls and isolated environments for data privacy.
